Class LPCCompilerContext

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.language.compiler.LPCCompilerContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
LPCCompilationEnvironment
public final class LPCCompilerContext extends Object implements LPCCompilationEnvironment
Source resolution, compatibility transforms and callable declarations for LPC compilation.

This context is safe to construct for a compiler, formatter or test without constructing a world. Its caches contain parsed declarations, never live LPC objects. A hosted runtime can share its efun registry so compilation sees exactly the signatures that execution will expose.
